module: M21 follow-up (CF-282: password reset, MFA enrolment, account security)

results.name: P1 the admin sign-in links to "Forgot your password?" (/admin/forgot-password, no session needed)
A11Y axe (forgot password) no serious / critical violations
P2 the answer is identical for an unknown e-mail and a real account; only the real account gets a link (written to the local server log — no e-mail is sent here)
P3 the reset link opens "Choose a new password"; the token is removed from the address bar
P4 a short password and two different passwords are refused before anything is sent
A11Y axe (reset password) no serious / critical violations
P5 password changed through the link: the old password no longer signs in, the new one does, and the link cannot be used twice
S1 "Account security" is reached from the profile menu and shows MFA (Off), Password and Signed-in devices
A11Y axe (account security) no serious / critical violations
S2 another signed-in device is listed and can be signed out from here; this device has no such button
S3 changing the password needs the correct current password (refused by the backend)
S4 password changed back from the screen: the fixture password signs in again, the temporary one does not; this session stays signed in
M1 setup shows a QR code drawn in the browser and the key for manual entry
A11Y axe (MFA setup) no serious / critical violations
M2 a wrong code does not switch MFA on
M3 the right code switches MFA on and the recovery codes are shown once; "Continue" waits for "I have saved these codes"
M4 the page shows MFA On (state re-read from the backend) and the codes are gone from the screen
M5 nothing secret is kept in the browser: no setup key, recovery code or password in storage
M6 the next sign-in asks for a code after the password (and the API issues no token before it)
M7 signed in with password + authenticator code
M8 turning MFA off needs the current password as well as a code (refused with a wrong password)
M9 MFA is off again: the password alone signs in
M10 the security events show the whole story (reset requested, password changed, MFA enabled, wrong MFA / sign-ins, MFA disabled) — without any secret

results.name: R1 the Restaurant Dashboard has the same screens: forgot-password link, reset page (an incomplete link sends nothing), Account security with MFA, password and devices
R2 "Sign out everywhere" ends this session too and returns to the sign-in form
V1 Account security at 390 px: no horizontal page overflow
Z no uncaught page errors or console errors
